## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
This should not merge yet. The change to `zzz-release/gate.py` blocks a release that has exactly the required number of approvals, and that contradicts the module's own docstring. The `healthy` rewrite gives the same result for the list inputs the tests use. The catalog regeneration renames all 1,500 entries and moves their ports from `1xxxx` to `2xxxx`. It also adds a top-level string key, `review_note`, at `aaa-generated/catalog.json:6003`. Nothing in the repository reads the catalog, so I found no realistic way that key breaks anything.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Changing `approvals >= minimum` to `approvals > minimum` makes `approved(2, minimum=2)` return `False`. That contradicts the docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1`, "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." The tests can't catch it: `tests/test_release.py:12` checks 3 and `tests/test_release.py:16` checks 1, so the boundary value 2 is never tried. Can you restore `>=` and add `assert gate.approved(2, minimum=2)`? — Any release with exactly the minimum approvals (2 with the default setting) is now rejected. The current tests still pass, so the regression would ship without warning.

## Strengths
- In `services/registry.py:88`, `not failures` gives the same result as the old `len(failures) == 0` for the empty and non-empty lists in `tests/test_release.py:20-21`.

## Not reviewed
- I didn't read all of the `aaa-generated/catalog.json` hunk line by line. I read diff lines 1–2233 and 8960–9009 of `../pr.diff`. For lines 2234–8959, I only pattern-scanned every added and removed line to confirm each is a `production-service-NNNN`/`legacy-service-NNNN` key or a `port` line.
- The repository has no generator script or source spec for `aaa-generated/catalog.json`. I couldn't check whether the new names and `2xxxx` ports match the new environment, or whether `review_note` would survive the next regeneration.
- Code outside this repository that reads `aaa-generated/catalog.json` or `services/registry.py` wasn't available. Nothing in this repository reads the catalog.
